2607.00362.title: SoK: Attack and Defense Landscape of Mobile On-device AI Systems
2607.00362.paper_summary: Mobile on-device AI (MoAI) systems that integrate locally deployed AI models with conventional mobile software components are emerging as a key paradigm for delivering intelligent functionality directly on end-user devices. By moving inference from remote cloud services to the local mobile environment, such systems enable privacy-preserving, low-latency, and offline-capable AI functionality, yet introduce new security risks arising from the local storage of AI models. This paper presents the first comprehensive systematization of knowledge on MoAI security, covering security pillars, attack landscape, and defense landscape of MoAI systems. We further identify unresolved gaps in current attack and defense research and point to promising directions for future research in this emerging area. Our work establishes the first systematic framework for understanding the attack and defense landscapes of MoAI systems, serving as a foundation for building secure MoAI systems and advancing research in this critical domain. Companion resources are available at https://github.com/Jinxhy/Awesome-MoAI-Security.
2607.00362.paper_summary_zh: 移動裝置上的人工智慧（MoAI）系統將本地部署的人工智慧模型與傳統的移動軟體組件整合，正逐漸成為直接在終端用戶設備上提供智能功能的關鍵範式。通過將推斷從遠端雲服務轉移到本地移動環境，這些系統實現了保護隱私、低延遲和離線能力的人工智慧功能，但同時也引入了由於本地儲存人工智慧模型而產生的新安全風險。本文首次全面系統化了有關MoAI安全性的知識，涵蓋了MoAI系統的安全支柱、攻擊景觀和防禦景觀。我們進一步識別了當前攻擊和防禦研究中的未解決空白，並指出了在這一新興領域未來研究的有前景方向。我們的工作建立了理解MoAI系統攻擊和防禦景觀的首個系統框架，為構建安全的MoAI系統和推進該關鍵領域的研究奠定了基礎。伴隨資源可在 https://github.com/Jinxhy/Awesome-MoAI-Security 獲得。
